system.description:
You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses for the next hour.

As long as the creature is within one mile of you, you can maintain this connection. This connection ends early if you or the connected creature takes damage.

While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.
